rules.statement: The Land Commissioner, as the judicial tribunal whose action is being tested, may be brought before a higher court through an application for certiorari if his determination under section 3 of the Land Development Ordinance is challenged.
rules.supporting_quote: "their Lordships consider that if the authority of a Land Commissioner to make a determination under section 3 of the Land Development Ordinance is challenged the appropriate procedure is by way of an application for certiorari"
